title: Assessment Criteria in Granting Approval to Organise In-person Global Conferences Amidst COVID-19 Pandemic
what_it_is: Assessment Criteria in Granting Approval to Organise In-person Global Conferences Amidst COVID-19 Pandemic

sections.label: Safe Business Events framework requirements
sections.summary: Event organisers must meet strict public health requirements, and the framework has been applied to over 29 business events.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: Under the framework, event organisers must comply with strict public health requirements, including pre-departure and on-arrival testing, a rigorous testing regime, the mandatory wearing of masks, as well as all relevant safe management measures at the event.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: The Safe Business Events framework has been applied to over 29 business events since its launch, including the Singapore International Energy Week in October last year and TravelRevive in November last year.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: As we are still working out the details and the logistical arrangements of the event, we are unable to share the costs and revenues at this point.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: After careful considerations, and in light of the current COVID-19 situation, the Forum had approached Singapore to discuss the possibility of holding its special annual meeting in Singapore and the Forum ultimately made the decision that Singapore was the best place to host the meeting.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: We are confident that this meeting will have: one, a positive impact on Singapore's economy and international standing; two, it will have a direct benefit on the companies supporting the event, including local companies; three, it will send a strong signal of confidence in Singapore's ability to host major international events in a safe and innovative way.

sections.label: WEF event announcement and postponement
sections.summary: MTI and WEF announced Singapore would host the event in May, and WEF proposed postponing it to 17 to 20 August.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: On 7 December, MTI and WEF concurrently issued press releases respectively to announce Singapore would host the event in May.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: On 3 February, WEF proposed to postpone it to 17 to 20 August.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: The first is that we are slowly opening up our events in hybrid manner.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: So, if you look at what we have done over the course of the year – about 29 different events including the Singapore International Energy Week, TravelRevive, SFF and SWITCH – we have now started to build muscles to ensure that we can safely and innovatively conduct events that are in hybrid format, and to ensure safe in-person meeting with all the relevant prevailing safe management measures in place.
